canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

universe_construction.rule: symbol has >=1 point-in-time SP500 membership interval AND >=1 stored bar
universe_construction.missing_from_bars_note: symbols ever recorded as SP500 members with zero stored bars -- unrecoverable from existing data, full list in output manifest, not enumerated in this spec for size
universe_construction.date_alignment: each symbol's closes reindexed onto SPY's own stored trading-date calendar from 2001-01-01 onward (not forward-filled); NOT a true set-intersection across all symbols -- see protocol section 3
universe_construction.alignment_start_rationale: point-in-time source maintainer (fja05680/sp500) flags 1996-2000 as lower-confidence

scope_decision: New masked engine (backend/app/research.py:rotation_pooled_correlation_masked, cross_sectional_momentum_bootstrap, 0.81.0) -- each rebalance date's rank restricted to real point-in-time SP500 members with real price data at formation/decision/forward dates, per protocol section 4. No cluster/sector breadth gate (no equity sector classification exists in this codebase, same as the feasibility protocol).

formation.definition: F(t) = close(t)/close(t-126) - 1, per eligible asset, computed through close t only
formation.rationale: identical to the feasibility check -- Jegadeesh and Titman (1993) 6-month formation horizon; no new pre-lock peek

holding.rationale: identical to the feasibility check -- classic 1-month forward return

rebalance_grid.definition: rebalance dates at session indices 126, 147, 168, ... through the last index with a full forward window available, on the SPY-anchored calendar

conditions: symbol in members_asof(date(t)) -- real point-in-time SP500 membership
close(t), close(t-126), close(t+21) all present (not NaN)
eligibility_mask.membership_never_resampled: membership is a fixed calendar fact, held identical across every bootstrap resample -- only the return panel is block-permuted, per protocol section 6

rank.tie_breaking: average rank (ties split the contested rank positions evenly)
rank.cross_sectional_n: varies by rebalance date -- only real point-in-time eligible members are ranked, not a fixed 501

estimand.statistic: pooled Spearman rank correlation between formation rank and forward rank, across all (eligible asset, rebalance date) pairs
estimand.evidential_status: confirmatory, subject to the residual survivorship-bias caveat in protocol section 2 -- not fully clean like a fresh preregistered test would be absent any data limitation

bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled pooled correlation >= observed, plus add-one correction
bootstrap.joint_resampling: the same resampled date-block sequence is applied to all assets simultaneously in each resample, preserving real contemporaneous cross-asset correlation; the eligibility mask itself is NOT resampled -- held fixed at its real value in every iteration
bootstrap.null_fill_caveat: a symbol's real history shorter than the full aligned calendar is forward/back-filled with flat, zero-return placeholders so the bootstrap's log-return machinery can run; the OBSERVED correlation never touches a filled value (eligibility mask is built from real, unfilled data), but a resampled iteration can still draw a block from a filled segment, narrowing that resample's variance slightly -- conservative-leaning, not anti-conservative, disclosed in protocol section 6b

material_and_consistent_requires: reported together with the section-2 residual-survivorship-bias caveat, never as an unqualified confirmation
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical correlation/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked formation window, holding horizon, and eligibility design

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope -- this tests the estimand only, per hypothesis-engineering.md's separation of claim and trade; a later executable expression is separate, independently justified work
scope_exclusions.no_sector_breadth_gate: no equity sector/industry classification exists in this codebase
scope_exclusions.residual_survivorship_bias: see protocol section 2 -- 705 of 1206 ever-SP500 members have zero stored bars and are absent from this universe entirely

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date over (symbol, date, close) triples actually used in the aligned panel (NaN-dropped positions excluded), plus the eligibility mask itself
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time
